Get some extra firepower on the field if you can!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 26 (Formerly, [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Necrotic Skeleton''' is an enemy that appears in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode, [[Challenge Trials]] and [[Badlands II]]. In [[Challenge Maps]] and [[The Takeover Event]], it does not appear naturally, and is instead summoned by the [[Fallen King]] and [[Fallen Summoner]]. In all other modes, it does appear naturally, though in [[Badlands II]], it is always a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy. It has a decent amount of health and walks quite fast. The '''Necrotic Skeleton''' is also a support enemy, as it has two abilities which debuff towers and buff enemies, both upon death. Its first ability is '''Gooey Demise''', which causes it to apply a 35% [[Firerate Debuff]] (53.85% increase) to every tower in its 15 radius for 3 seconds. Its second ability is ''Essence of Life'', which makes it leave four puddles of purple goo on the path. These puddles heal any enemy that walks over them by 60 every 0.5 seconds. They last 15 seconds. ==Logbook Description== "''Necrotic Skeletons were once Fallen Necromancers who pushed their dark arts too far. The curse consumed them entirely, leaving only bones saturated with volatile necromantic energy. When destroyed, they unleash the corruption stored within, spreading the curse to everything nearby. They are warnings of what happens when one embraces the darkness completely.''" ==Appearance== The '''Necrotic Skeleton''' is made entirely of sand colored parts that resemble a skeletal humanoid. It does not have a full torso, but instead has the bone cage for it. Its head is a skull with large neon blue eyes and horns. It wears a grey chestplate and shoulder-pads. Upon death, the '''Necrotic Skeleton''' will fall over and create a trail of purple goo in front of it. ==Strategy== *The '''Necrotic Skeleton''' is a support enemy. Upon death, it will both debuff towers and buff enemies. **It will debuff towers by applying an 35% [[Firerate Debuff]] to them, though it is quite short. ***The [[Commander]] and [[Medic]] can be used to partially mitigate its [[Firerate Debuff]]. **Its puddles will heal any enemy that walks over it by 60 health every 0.5 seconds, regenerating their health. ***As it is rather fast, it will get to the front of enemies quite quickly, allowing it to regenerate their health. Additionally, it will be swiftly killed by towers as its health is much lower than most enemies that appear around the same time as it. *High DPS towers, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Turret]] and [[Accelerator]] can be quite effective against this, as it has quite low health. **High DPS towers with splash damage capabilities, such as the [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]] can be quite useful, as they can damage both the '''Necrotic Skeletons''' and the enemies that summoned them. **In [[Badlands II]], it is recommended that these towers have hidden detection, due to the '''Necrotic Skeleton''' being a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy there. ***The [[Firework Technician]] or [[Ace Pilot]] can be used to give hidden detection to your towers, if you lack it, while the [[Spotlight Tech]] can be used to expose the '''Necrotic Skeletons'''. *Area of effect towers, like the [[Mortar]], [[Rocketeer]] and [[Tesla]] can be quite useful at killing the '''Necrotic Skeletons''', as they spawn in hordes. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} NecroticSkeletonRun.gif|Running animation (2 August 2024 – Present) NecroticSkeletonStun.gif|Stun animation (2 August 2024 – Present) NecroticSkeletonDeath.gif|Death animation (2 August 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1NecroSkeleton.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseNecroticSkeleton1.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} FallenFoesThumbnail.png|'''Necrotic Skeleton''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Tesla Tower Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Necrotic Skeleton''" on a promotional video.
